resources.string: Galaxy S26 Ultra · AZF1 only · removed on reboot
Verifying KernelSU and the Shizuku connection.
If KernelSU modules or LSPosed are not active, run these in order.
Reapplies KernelSU modules. Does not restart the device or the Android app runtime.
Restarts the Android app runtime so LSPosed can attach.
Technical info and run history. Not needed for normal use.

RAM-only method for SM-S948U AZF1 only. System partitions and Knox are not modified, and root is removed on reboot.\n\nThe device may reboot during the run, so save important work first. After success, per-app root permissions are managed in KernelSU.

Reruns the late-load, mount, and service stages of all currently active KernelSU modules. Other modules run too, so disable any suspect module first.\n\nThis does not restart the kernel or the Android app runtime. Run ‘soft boot’ when done.

Finish ‘module reload’ first. LSPosed and Zygisk attach to the newly started Android app runtime (Zygote).\n\nRunning apps and System UI will briefly stop. On some devices this may turn into a full reboot, which removes temporary root.
